Archive preflight reads gzip-wrapped tar review packets and LZ4-framed tar review packets with safe regular file/directory entries, skippable reviewer metadata, and validated frame checksums before exposing import bytes. Math/TeX handoff emits MathML semantics annotations carrying escaped source TeX for reviewer and accessibility tooling without invoking MathJax, KaTeX, or TeX engines. PDF review-packet handoff now records expected TeX sidecars, fake-produced artifact hashes, log warnings/errors, and rerun-needed signals so WordPress import queues can triage failed or incomplete PDF exports without running renderers.
